notes: Login node warrior is CentOS 7 (python3 is 3.6, no sysctl on PATH). $TMPDIR there points at CephFS, not the node. The image is an existing sandbox with Node 22 and Claude Code shared with Beethoven for VS Code; new images at this site should be SIF because the home is Panasas. claude_config_dir is the student's existing Claude Code login from Beethoven for VS Code; the framework only starts Claude Code there and reads 'claude auth status'. Until 2026-09-30 the lab folder was /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/ashley and the sign-in folder $HOME/.ashley/claude; both old names remain as links to the new ones, for builds older than Beethoven 8.0.0. scheduler_in_worker (framework 9): the host's Slurm client, its library, the munge library and socket, /etc/slurm and the slurm and munge users are bound into the worker's container, the set measured on asx1 on 2026-09-28 for the lab's VS Code tool. Framework 10: the portal answered an unauthenticated request with 401 and WWW-Authenticate Basic on 2026-10-01 (ood_auth http-basic, a hint only); grid_account_help_url is TeamDynamix's standard address for KB 20199 and was not fetched; the worker partition stays partition_cpu_batch (reqp/requeue), the lab lead's choice. Framework 11: ssh_host, ssh_port and ssh_host_key are what grid.wayne.edu:22 answered from the internet on 2026-10-02 (OpenSSH 7.4, host key ssh-rsa with that SHA256 fingerprint, publickey, password and keyboard-interactive offered; a password sign-in also asks for the Google Authenticator code, which grid_2fa_help_url, KB 20242, explains); ssh_relay is null (no relay); browser_key_days is absent (no expiry), the lab lead's choice. Framework 25: partitions_gpu gains galhp and qos_gpu is gpu, both as Beethoven for VS Code's GPU workers ask them (core/slurm.ts, --partition gmsap,gvohp,galhp --qos gpu); a GPU request without the QoS was refused on 2026-10-21. node_domain is the compute nodes' domain its ssh configuration reaches through the login node (core/sshConfig.ts, Host *.nas.grid.wayne.edu with ProxyJump), and only while a job of the account's runs on the node; neither was measured by hpcworker.
